label: Conditional on selecting the negative A3P1 answer, no possible event is impossible to cause
paraphrase: Conditional on selecting the negative A3P1 answer, no possible event is impossible to cause. An event is a change whose before/after states are essential to its identity; the question tooltip describes a cause as a prior condition capable of explaining or partly explaining that event. This is possible causal availability, not universal actual causation or complete sufficient explanation.
